name: Chacha Jamil
look: a grumpy old man with a bald head, tufts of white hair at the sides, huge bushy white eyebrows in a permanent scowl and a big white walrus moustache, slightly hunched; a brown knitted cardigan with leather elbow patches over a cream shirt, beige trousers rolled at the ankle, plaid slippers, leaning on a wooden cane
personality: Grumpy old neighbour who complains about everything and notices everything.
catchphrase: Hamare zamane mein koi chori nahi karta tha!

mouth.note: The mouth sits under the walrus moustache. Pose 2's brows and eyes are a little angrier, so patch only below the nose, never the eyes.

label: CHACHA JAMIL
catchphrase_say: हमारे ज़माने में कोई चोरी नहीं करता था!

voice.description: Rohit speaks in a very low-pitched, gruff and grumpy voice of an old man at a slow pace, expressive. The recording is very clear, close-sounding, with no background noise.
voice.note: Seed 7 chosen by studio/tune_parler.py: steadiest pitch and timbre across sentences.
